summary: Iter9 — Targeted verification of Google login button fix + auth regression. Backend: 6/6 pytest PASS (POST /api/auth/google/session with invalid session_id → 401 'Ugyldig Google-økt' ✓; missing session_id → 422 ✓; POST /api/auth/login ola@kjapp.no → JWT + user.role='user' ✓; GET /api/auth/me with bearer → user email ✓; POST /api/auth/register with fullName/email/password/phone → 200 + token ✓; POST /api/auth/logout with bearer → 200 ✓). Frontend: /login loads with 0 console errors; cookie consent banner appears within ~1s, 'Godta alle' stores localStorage['kjapp_cookie_consent']='all' ✓; Google button (data-testid='social-google') click ACTUALLY NAVIGATES the page to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=<current-origin>/auth/callback — confirmed via screenshot showing Google 'Sign in / to continue to emergentagent.com' page after click, proving the OAuth URL is well-formed and the non-standalone browser code path (window.location.href) is untouched and works. Email login ola@kjapp.no/test1234 → redirects to /app (map visible with 'Venter på sjåfør') ✓. 'Sjåfør-innlogging' link (data-testid='link-driver-login') navigates to /driver/login ✓. /driver/login page renders with dlogin-email/dlogin-password/dlogin-submit testids and NO social-google button (as intended) ✓.
action_items: No blockers. Google button fix verified for regular-browser code path via live navigation to Google OAuth via emergentagent.com. The PWA-standalone branch (window.open + fallback) is conservative and cannot be exercised by headless Playwright which never runs in display-mode:standalone; recommend a manual iOS Safari 'Add to Home Screen' smoke test to confirm the standalone fix end-to-end on the real device that reported the bug.

Minor doc mismatch: review request referred to a 'driver-login-form' data-testid on /driver/login — that specific testid does NOT exist. Actual driver login testids are dlogin-back / dlogin-email / dlogin-password / dlogin-submit / dlogin-error / dlogin-customer. Consider adding a wrapping data-testid='driver-login-form' to <form> in /app/frontend/src/pages/DriverLogin.jsx for easier future e2e targeting.
critical_code_review_comments: Login.jsx loginWithGoogle() correctly handles PWA standalone (matchMedia + navigator.standalone) with window.open + fallback to window.location.href — good defensive fix. `noopener` on window.open is correct (prevents popup access to opener).

Fallback path is inside `if (!win)` — window.open returning null indicates popup blocked, which the fallback handles. However some PWAs return a Window object that immediately closes; consider also checking `win.closed` after a short delay if bug persists on some Android PWAs.
REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL used from env; oauth URL and redirect built from window.location.origin — no hardcoding. Correct.
Register endpoint requires field name `fullName` (not `name`) — inconsistent with other user model fields where response uses `fullName` too. OK, just a naming choice to be aware of.

Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_iter9_auth.py alongside the master /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py from iter8. Google OAuth click was verified end-to-end by observing the real navigation to Google's sign-in page for emergentagent.com — no mocking. rca of the issue: Original user bug: Google login button unresponsive when app installed as PWA to home screen. RCA (from main agent): iOS Safari + some Android browsers silently block full-page redirects to external OAuth providers when running in display-mode: standalone. Fix in Login.jsx loginWithGoogle(): detect standalone via matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)') || navigator.standalone → use window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener') with a fallback to window.location.href when popup is blocked. Regular browser tabs unaffected (still use window.location.href). Verification: regular-browser path confirmed working via live click → arrived at Google sign-in via emergentagent.com. Standalone-mode path is code-review-verified but requires manual on-device test to fully confirm.
